identity.note: these three pre-registrations are written *after* the commit they name, so `dirty` is true here and the difference is exactly these files plus the P0' drivers under work/v03/. call_upper_bound.how: one vision request per look; a look is a round-boundary measurement, so the count follows the episode length and is capped by the frozen budget, never by this file

stop_rules: 3 consecutive requests dying of 429 / quota -> stop, keep the breakpoint, record it (SPEC §8.2)
the episode's own `max_http_requests` reached -> that episode's termination is a result, not an incident

unit_price.why: free tier, no price configured; the ledger rows carry per-call tokens and latency instead (SPEC §7.1)
